Name: Mapster - A Local Map Mod
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b][size=4]Mapster - A Local Map Mod[/size][/b] adds a searchable, full-screen local map viewer to Stardew Valley. Mapster lets you inspect local maps, modded locations, interiors, shops, dungeons, farms, and custom areas from one searchable interface. This does not replace the vanilla map. It includes an optional mini map. It can also integrate NPC Map Locations. It also has it's own app if you have Mobile Phone installed.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Open Mapster with [b]Left Ctrl + M[/b] by default. [/*]
[*]Search locations directly from the top dropdown/search bar. [/*]
[*]Browse loaded vanilla and modded locations. [/*]
[*]Preview any available location from the list. [/*]
[*]Mouse wheel zoom support. [/*]
[*]Right-click hold and drag to pan while zoomed in.[/*]
[*]Dropdown list with scroll support.[/*]
[*]Search text clears when clicking away or after selecting a location. [/*]
[*]Optional animated preview refresh through GMCM. [/*]
[*]Optional teleport-from-preview setting through GMCM.[/*]
[*]If NPC Map Locations is installed it will integrate into Mapster.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Controls [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Open Mapster - Left Ctrl + M [/*]
[*]Close Mapster - Escape / Controller B [/*]
[*]Search locations - Click the top bar and type [/*]
[*]Select location - Click a dropdown result [/*]
[*]Zoom map - Mouse wheel over the map [/*]
[*]Pan map - Right-click hold + drag while zoomed in [/*]
[*]Clear search - Click away without selecting[/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
Mapster shows locations that are currently loaded into the game. Some modded locations may not appear until the relevant mod has loaded or initialized them.
Animated map preview is available, but if you experience performance issues, turn it off in GMCM.

[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Mapster should work with vanilla and modded locations as long as they are loaded as normal Stardew Valley
[code]GameLocation[/code] entries. It does not replace maps or edit save data.

It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
